scene.title: Bubble Sort on [5, 1, 4, 2, 8]
scene.summary: Neighbours are compared and swapped until the largest values bubble to the end.

beats.title: Initial array
beats.narration: Bubble Sort walks through the list, comparing neighbours and swapping them when they are in the wrong order.

beats.title: Pass 1: compare 5 and 1
beats.narration: 5 is bigger than 1, so the two swap places.

beats.title: Pass 1: continue swaps
beats.narration: 5 moves right, swapping with 4 then 2, and stops before 8.

beats.title: Pass 2 and sorted
beats.narration: Pass 2 swaps 4 and 2, after which the array is sorted.
